data.name: Humd
data.gender_notes: Humd is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Humd is a name derived from the Arabic word 'humdah' which means 'praise' or 'glorify'. It is often used in Islamic prayers and poems to express gratitude and reverence towards Allah. The name Humd carries the meaning “Praise, Glorify” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Humd usually hope their child will grow to embody praise, glorify and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion, reverence, and the recognition of the divine.
data.etymology: Humd belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praise, Glorify.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humd total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
